Class TransactionsController.DisplayTransaction

java.lang.Object
com.duck.TransactionsController.DisplayTransaction
Enclosing class:
TransactionsController
public static class TransactionsController.DisplayTransaction extends Object
Lightweight DTO(Display Transaction Object) representing a single transaction row for the UI. Fields are public for convenient access during rendering.

    • DisplayTransaction

      public DisplayTransaction(String name, String category, double amount, String dateGroup, String svgPath)
      Constructs a DisplayTransaction with the given values.
      Parameters:
      name - display name for the transaction
      category - category label
      amount - signed amount (positive for income, negative for expense)
      dateGroup - human-readable date grouping string
      svgPath - SVG path data for the category icon
